_comment: Issue #81 (exploration & optional content): 'Renn's Old Warhammer' end to end, POSTING-SEEDED, SAME-MAP shape (both beats resolve on the guild, contrast missing_recruit_loop's cross-map one). FIXTURE-FIRST, reusing board_loop_start VERBATIM (no new fixture needed -- this quest needs nothing board_loop_start doesn't already carry). Proves, in order: (1) a REAL guild_board browse banks heard_about_lost_hammer (the same board also carries rumor_missing_recruit, banked as a side effect); (2) Renn's gated 'ask' option starts the quest; (3) renns_gear_stash (an always-present container, no gate) grants the item + completes beat 1, live; (4) returning to Renn and turning in the item completes beat 2 + the whole quest (item-gated turn-in option, requires:{item:renns_warhammer}) with the 3-gold payout. The lore-note thread's third find (note_old_dread) was originally staged in this same corner but RELOCATED to the barracks after the scene_dynamism tool flagged a net regression here (see that entity's own skeleton_scene.json comment) -- barracks_walkthrough.json carries its own live coverage instead. Seed 9 for convention; fixture rng_state governs (no combat in this script).

steps._comment: == (1) THE REQUEST BOARD == (8,3) down3 -> (8,6), left7 -> (1,6), up3 -> (1,3) (the board_loop.json proven route), right1 blocks on guild_board (2,3) & faces it. Reading the board banks BOTH #81 rumors (this quest reads exactly one of them, the other rides along).

_interact_board banks read_the_board + every board_rumors accomplishment BEFORE opening the code-built dialogue -- wait the rumor bank first, dialogue_started second (the missing_recruit_loop lesson).

== (2) RENN, ASK == (1,3) up1 -> (1,2), right2 -> (3,2), down1 blocks on renn (3,3) & faces it. First interact is the talk_pool bark (fresh waking); second reaches the real renn_hammer graph. Visible options: [0] Just passing through., [1] I hear you're missing a warhammer. (the turn-in option stays hidden -- the item isn't held yet).

payload_contains.speaker: Renn
payload_contains.text: Four silver for a nest clear? Four? My arrows cost more than that if it goes badly.

payload_contains.speaker: Renn
payload_contains.text: Backup hammer. Left it propped against the back wall last time I hauled kit through here, and it's not there now, and Ilvo will not stop laughing about it.

steps._comment: == (3) THE GEAR STASH == (3,2) up1 -> (3,1), right11 -> (13,1) (the 11th step blocks on renns_gear_stash (14,1) & faces it). Container interact grants the item + completes beat 1 directly (no dialogue involved).

payload_contains.text: Quest updated: Return the warhammer to Renn, at the Guild.

steps._comment: == JOURNAL CHECK == found_notes stays EMPTY here -- this run never picks up a note_ item (renns_warhammer is kind:parcel but not note_-prefixed). Proves the Lore section's own 'omit entirely, no filler' contract (the Effects-section precedent) alongside missing_recruit_loop's/barracks_walkthrough's positive coverage.
steps.name: journal

steps._comment: == (4) RENN, RETURN == (13,1) left10 -> (3,1), down2 -> (3,2) (the second down step blocks on renn (3,3) & faces it). social_talked is still set from step (2) (same waking), so a SINGLE interact reaches the graph directly. Visible options now: [0] Just passing through., [1] Found this by the back wall. Yours? (the ask option is hidden -- hammer_quest_started already banked).

payload_contains.speaker: Renn
payload_contains.text: It WAS the back wall. I told him. Three gold, and don't tell Ilvo I paid for this — actually, tell him. It'll shut him up faster than the gold will.
